dialog.about.privacy.text.value: While you use the app, anonymous usage events (clicks, keystrokes — never the text content of fields) are sent to PostHog so I can see which features people actually reach for. If you click "🐞 Report bug", the last few minutes of your activity in this page are recorded as a video-like replay and sent along with your message so I can reproduce what you saw. Password fields are never captured. Nothing leaves your browser unless you click Send. Reports auto-delete from storage after 90 days. The desktop app sends a smaller, separate set of anonymous events to a different PostHog project for the same reason; users can opt out by setting SANGEET_ANALYTICS_DISABLED=1.

dialog.about.privacy.desktop.value: Anonymous usage stats (which features get touched, how long sessions are — never the content you type) are sent to PostHog so I can prioritise what to build next. Set the SANGEET_ANALYTICS_DISABLED=1 environment variable to turn this off.
